Debug only: check password manager suggestions
KeyCorrect has no internet access. Everything you type stays on this device.
What KeyCorrect has learned from your typing
Adapt suggestions and autocorrect to the words you use. Everything stays on this device.
Pause learning for now. Learning is always off automatically in password and private fields.

Turning learning off, or using Incognito, stops new learning. What was already learned, and recent learning history (kept up to 24 hours, encrypted), stay until you use Forget or Reset. Reset keeps your personal dictionary words.
Turn on learning to use this option.
Keep recent sentences for on-device training
Stored encrypted on this device and deleted after 7 days. Never taken from password or private fields.
Undo what KeyCorrect learned from your typing in the last while. Older learning is kept.
Words and corrections learned in that time, and recently used emoji, are removed. Your personal dictionary entries and shortcuts that you added yourself are kept. This can\'t be undone.
Nothing to forget from that time
Typos it now fixes for you
Added because you undid a correction
Words you type again and again, or keep after an autocorrect, show up here.
When you fix the same typo the same way a few times, KeyCorrect will fix it for you and list it here.
When you undo an autocorrect, KeyCorrect stops making that correction and lists it here.
Words you choose \u201CNever suggest\u201D for appear here.
How closely your taps land on the keys you meant. Only positions are recorded, never text. Spread is in key sizes: smaller means more precise.
No data yet. It builds up as you type.
Keyboard size recommendations will appear here once there\'s enough data.
Forget everything KeyCorrect learned from your typing, including stored sentences. Your personal dictionary words are kept.

This erases everything KeyCorrect learned from your typing: word frequencies, learned corrections, never-correct and never-suggest lists, typing accuracy data, stored sentences, and recently used emoji with their skin tone choices. Your personal dictionary and text shortcuts are kept. This can\'t be undone.
What KeyCorrect learned couldn\'t be loaded. It will try again automatically while you type. If this keeps happening you can reset the learning data.
Move the cursor with the spacebar
Drag on the right half of the spacebar to move the cursor, on the left half to select.
Slide across the letters to type a word
Swipe left on backspace to select words; let go to delete them.
Hold the comma key to dictate, on this device
Hold the comma key to dictate. The microphone is on only while the listening bar shows, and never in password fields.

Built-in uses the KeyCorrect voice pack, and audio never leaves this device. It never switches to another recognizer: without the pack, dictation says so. Phone recognizer is your phone\'s own speech service instead.

The phone\'s recognizer may send what you say to its provider\'s servers (for example Google). It is never used in incognito or in fields that ask for no personalised learning; dictation shows a message there.
Voice pack: installed. Dictation runs on this device with the Moonshine model.
Voice pack: not installed. Install it from the KeyCorrect releases page to dictate with the built-in engine.
Voice pack: not trusted. It is not signed by the same key as this keyboard, so it is not used.
Voice pack: installed but incomplete or unsupported on this device, so it is not used.
How long you can speak without a pause before the phrase is cut. Shorter is steadier on slow phones; the model can\'t go much past 9 s.
Pause before a phrase is final
How long a pause must last before what you said is decoded and kept.
How often the words refresh while you speak. Auto follows how fast the phone decodes; a fixed time slows down if the phone can\'t keep up. Off shows words after each pause.
Stop dictating when nothing is said for this long. The bar counts down in the last 3 seconds.
Add commas and full stops while dictating, when the engine can.
Show an emoji next to the suggestions when a word you type clearly matches one, such as pizza.
Used for emoji that come in skin tones, unless you chose another tone for that emoji by holding it.

Keep what you copy while this is your keyboard, and paste it from the clipboard panel (hold the emoji key). Everything is kept as it is; you delete what you don\'t want. It is stored encrypted, and nothing is kept in incognito mode.
Pinned clips are kept in addition to this.
Also keep copied images, up to 20 MB in all. They are encrypted and only shared with the app you paste them into.
Deletes every clip, pinned ones too.
Every clip and saved image is deleted, pinned ones too. This can\'t be undone.
Image copied. Paste it with the app\'s own paste.
Move your settings and learned data to another device

Saves your settings, personal dictionary, shortcuts, learned typing data and touch data to a file you choose. Clipboard history is not included. Nothing leaves the device unless you move the file yourself.
Without a passphrase the file is not encrypted, and anyone who has it can read it, including the words you typed.
The file will be encrypted. Keep the passphrase: without it the file cannot be opened.
Couldn\'t export. The file was not written.
Export cancelled \u2014 please enter the passphrase again. Nothing was written.
Your learned data isn\'t available right now, so nothing was exported.
Reads a backup made by KeyCorrect. You choose what happens to the data already on this device.
Enter the passphrase this backup was exported with.
That passphrase is wrong, or the file is damaged. Try again.
You already merged this backup on %1$s. Merging it again adds its counts twice.
What to do with the data on this device
Adds the backup\'s words, shortcuts and learning to what is here. This device\'s data is kept. Settings from the backup replace the current ones.
Erases the learned data and settings on this device first, then takes the backup\'s.

This backup comes from a device with a different screen (%1$d×%2$d px, %3$d dpi). Where you tap on keys depends on screen size and hand position, so touch patterns and key sizes from it would likely be wrong here. They\'ll be skipped.
Import touch data and key sizes anyway
This erases the learned data on this device. Your settings are replaced too. This can\'t be undone.
Touch data and key sizes were skipped because the screen is different.
The data was imported, but this screen couldn\'t refresh everything. Restart the keyboard to finish.
The data was imported, but the settings couldn\'t be written.
Couldn\'t import. Nothing on this device was changed.
That file is not a KeyCorrect backup.
This backup was made by a newer version of KeyCorrect. Update the app and try again.
The backup is damaged and can\'t be read.
The backup is too large to import.
